name: Jeveration generates an image in one forward pass
title: Jeveration generates an image in one forward pass
summary: National University of Singapore researchers show a frozen vision-language model can emit a full image as one parallel decision. Jeveration makes a 512px image in 78 ms on one H200, up to 122x faster than compared unified models, and the same checkpoint also does image-to-image generation and dense prediction.

appearances.title: Jeveration generates images in one system-one pass
appearances.summary: Jeveration uses a frozen Qwen3.5-4B vision-language model as a system-one decision model that emits a full image in one forward pass. A 512 by 512 image takes about 78 ms on one H200, up to 122 times faster than Janus-Pro-7B, at 0.74 GenEval. The same checkpoint also does image-to-image generation and dense prediction.
